concepts.label: ftsMemoryQuota (Search Service per-node memory quota setting)
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - minted earlier in this batch (fts-advance-settings-maxConcurrentPartitionMovesPerNode.json); this is the setting's own dedicated page

notable_absence.finding: Unlike most of this batch's sibling pages, this page never states ftsMemoryQuota's own default numeric value - only sizing guidance ('set the ftsMemoryQuota to 80% or less of the total available RAM for that node' when Search is the only service on the node).

cross_component_finding: This is the only page in the batch whose configuration surface is exclusively the Couchbase Server Web Console ('You can configure the `ftsMemoryQuota` from the Couchbase Server Web Console at any time', via Settings > Memory Quotas > Search field), with no REST/curl example at all - every other page in the batch shows a curl call against fts:manager-options-endpoint (port 8094) as its primary or only configuration method. This corroborates the maxConcurrentPartitionMovesPerNode page's own grouping of ftsMemoryQuota alongside maxFeedsPerDCPAgent and maxConcurrentPartitionMovesPerNode as a rebalance-throughput tuning trio, while showing ftsMemoryQuota is configured through a visibly different (UI-only) surface than its two partners in that trio.
